5namespace GuzzleHttp\Promise;
6
7/**
8 * Promises/A+ implementation that avoids recursion when possible.
9 *
10 * @template TValue = mixed
11 * @template TReason = mixed
12 *
13 * @implements PromiseInterface<TValue, TReason>
14 *
15 * @see https://promisesaplus.com/
16 *
17 * @final
18 */
19class Promise implements PromiseInterface
20{
21    use NonSerializableTrait;
22
23    /** @var self::PENDING|self::FULFILLED|self::REJECTED */
24    private string $state = self::PENDING;
25
26    /** @var TValue|TReason|PromiseInterface<TValue, TReason>|null */
27    private $result;
28
29    /** @var (callable(): void)|null */
30    private $cancelFn;
31
32    /** @var (callable(bool): void)|null */
33    private $waitFn;
34
35    /** @var list<Promise<mixed, mixed>>|null */
36    private ?array $waitList = null;
37
38    /** @var list<array{0: PromiseInterface<mixed, mixed>, 1: callable|null, 2: callable|null}>|null */
39    private ?array $handlers = [];
40
41    /**
42     * @param (callable(bool): void)|null $waitFn   Fn that when invoked resolves the promise.
43     * @param (callable(): void)|null     $cancelFn Fn that when invoked cancels the promise.
44     */
45    public function __construct(
46        ?callable $waitFn = null,
47        ?callable $cancelFn = null
48    ) {
49        $this->waitFn = $waitFn;
50        $this->cancelFn = $cancelFn;
51    }
52
53    /**
54     * @template TFulfilledValue = never
55     * @template TFulfilledReason = never
56     * @template TRejectedValue = never
57     * @template TRejectedReason = never
58     *
59     * @param (callable(TValue): (TFulfilledValue|PromiseInterface<TFulfilledValue, TFulfilledReason>))|null $onFulfilled Invoked when the promise fulfills.
60     * @param (callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>))|null   $onRejected  Invoked when the promise is rejected.
61     *
62     * @return PromiseInterface<($onFulfilled is null ? TValue : TFulfilledValue)|($onRejected is null ? never : TRejectedValue), ($onFulfilled is null ? never : TFulfilledReason|\Throwable)|($onRejected is null ? TReason : TRejectedReason|\Throwable)>
63     */
64    public function then(
65        ?callable $onFulfilled = null,
66        ?callable $onRejected = null
67    ): PromiseInterface {
68        if ($this->state === self::PENDING) {
69            $p = new Promise(null, [$this, 'cancel']);
70            $this->handlers[] = [$p, $onFulfilled, $onRejected];
71            $p->waitList = $this->waitList;
72            $p->waitList[] = $this;
73
74            return $p;
75        }
76
77        // Return a fulfilled promise and immediately invoke any callbacks.
78        if ($this->state === self::FULFILLED) {
79            $promise = Create::promiseFor($this->result);
80
81            return $promise->then($onFulfilled, $onRejected);
82        }
83
84        // It's either cancelled or rejected, so return a rejected promise
85        // and immediately invoke any callbacks.
86        $rejection = Create::rejectionFor($this->result);
87
88        /** @var PromiseInterface<($onFulfilled is null ? TValue : TFulfilledValue)|($onRejected is null ? never : TRejectedValue), ($onFulfilled is null ? never : TFulfilledReason|\Throwable)|($onRejected is null ? TReason : TRejectedReason|\Throwable)> $promise */
89        $promise = $onRejected ? $rejection->then(null, $onRejected) : $rejection;
90
91        return $promise;
92    }
93
94    /**
95     * @template TRejectedValue = never
96     * @template TRejectedReason = never
97     *
98     * @param callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>) $onRejected Invoked when the promise is rejected.
99     *
100     * @return PromiseInterface<TValue|TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason|\Throwable>
101     */
102    public function otherwise(callable $onRejected): PromiseInterface
103    {
104        return $this->then(null, $onRejected);
105    }
106
107    public function wait(bool $unwrap = true)
108    {
109        $this->waitIfPending();
110
111        if ($this->result instanceof PromiseInterface) {
112            return $this->result->wait($unwrap);
113        }
114        if ($unwrap) {
115            if ($this->state === self::FULFILLED) {
116                return $this->result;
117            }
118            // It's rejected so "unwrap" and throw an exception.
119            throw Create::exceptionFor($this->result);
120        }
121
122        return null;
123    }
124
125    public function getState(): string
126    {
127        return $this->state;
128    }
129
130    public function cancel(): void
131    {
132        if ($this->state !== self::PENDING) {
133            return;
134        }
135
136        $this->waitFn = $this->waitList = null;
137
138        if ($this->cancelFn) {
139            $fn = $this->cancelFn;
140            $this->cancelFn = null;
141            try {
142                $fn();
143            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
144                $this->reject($e);
145            }
146        }
147
148        // Reject the promise only if it wasn't rejected in a then callback.
149        /** @psalm-suppress RedundantCondition */
150        if ($this->state === self::PENDING) {
151            $this->reject(new CancellationException('Promise has been cancelled'));
152        }
153    }
154
155    public function resolve($value = null): void
156    {
157        $this->settle(self::FULFILLED, $value);
158    }
159
160    public function reject($reason): void
161    {
162        $this->settle(self::REJECTED, $reason);
163    }
164
165    private function settle(string $state, $value): void
166    {
167        if ($this->state !== self::PENDING) {
168            // Ignore calls with the same resolution.
169            if ($state === $this->state && $value === $this->result) {
170                return;
171            }
172            throw $this->state === $state
173                ? new \LogicException("The promise is already {$state}.")
174                : new \LogicException("Cannot change a {$this->state} promise to {$state}");
175        }
176
177        if ($value === $this) {
178            throw new \LogicException('Cannot fulfill or reject a promise with itself');
179        }
180
181        // Clear out the state of the promise but stash the handlers.
182        $this->state = $state;
183        $this->result = $value;
184        $handlers = $this->handlers;
185        $this->handlers = null;
186        $this->waitList = $this->waitFn = null;
187        $this->cancelFn = null;
188
189        if (!$handlers) {
190            return;
191        }
192
193        // If the value was not a settled promise or a thenable, then resolve
194        // it in the task queue using the correct ID.
195        if (!is_object($value) || !method_exists($value, 'then')) {
196            $id = $state === self::FULFILLED ? 1 : 2;
197            // It's a success, so resolve the handlers in the queue.
198            Utils::queue()->add(static function () use ($id, $value, $handlers): void {
199                foreach ($handlers as $handler) {
200                    self::callHandler($id, $value, $handler);
201                }
202            });
203        } elseif ($value instanceof Promise && Is::pending($value)) {
204            // We can just merge our handlers onto the next promise.
205            $value->handlers = array_merge($value->handlers, $handlers);
206        } else {
207            // Resolve the handlers when the forwarded promise is resolved.
208            $value->then(
209                static function ($value) use ($handlers): void {
210                    foreach ($handlers as $handler) {
211                        self::callHandler(1, $value, $handler);
212                    }
213                },
214                static function ($reason) use ($handlers): void {
215                    foreach ($handlers as $handler) {
216                        self::callHandler(2, $reason, $handler);
217                    }
218                }
219            );
220        }
221    }
222
223    /**
224     * Call a stack of handlers using a specific callback index and value.
225     *
226     * @param int   $index   1 (resolve) or 2 (reject).
227     * @param mixed $value   Value to pass to the callback.
228     * @param array $handler Array of handler data (promise and callbacks).
229     */
230    private static function callHandler(int $index, $value, array $handler): void
231    {
232        /** @var PromiseInterface<mixed, mixed> $promise */
233        $promise = $handler[0];
234
235        // The promise may have been cancelled or resolved before placing
236        // this thunk in the queue.
237        if (Is::settled($promise)) {
238            return;
239        }
240
241        try {
242            if (isset($handler[$index])) {
243                /*
244                 * If $f throws an exception, then $handler will be in the exception
245                 * stack trace. Since $handler contains a reference to the callable
246                 * itself we get a circular reference. We clear the $handler
247                 * here to avoid that memory leak.
248                 */
249                $f = $handler[$index];
250                unset($handler);
251                $promise->resolve($f($value));
252            } elseif ($index === 1) {
253                // Forward resolution values as-is.
254                $promise->resolve($value);
255            } else {
256                // Forward rejections down the chain.
257                $promise->reject($value);
258            }
259        } catch (\Throwable $reason) {
260            $promise->reject($reason);
261        }
262    }
263
264    private function waitIfPending(): void
265    {
266        if ($this->state !== self::PENDING) {
267            return;
268        } elseif ($this->waitFn) {
269            $this->invokeWaitFn();
270        } elseif ($this->waitList) {
271            $this->invokeWaitList();
272        } else {
273            // If there's no wait function, then reject the promise.
274            $this->reject('Cannot wait on a promise that has '
275                .'no internal wait function. You must provide a wait '
276                .'function when constructing the promise to be able to '
277                .'wait on a promise.');
278        }
279
280        Utils::queue()->run();
281
282        /** @psalm-suppress RedundantCondition */
283        if ($this->state === self::PENDING) {
284            $this->reject('Invoking the wait callback did not resolve the promise');
285        }
286    }
287
288    private function invokeWaitFn(): void
289    {
290        try {
291            $wfn = $this->waitFn;
292            $this->waitFn = null;
293            $wfn(true);
294        } catch (\Throwable $reason) {
295            if ($this->state === self::PENDING) {
296                // The promise has not been resolved yet, so reject the promise
297                // with the exception.
298                $this->reject($reason);
299            } else {
300                // The promise was already resolved, so there's a problem in
301                // the application.
302                throw $reason;
303            }
304        }
305    }
306
307    private function invokeWaitList(): void
308    {
309        $waitList = $this->waitList;
310        $this->waitList = null;
311
312        foreach ($waitList as $result) {
313            do {
314                $result->waitIfPending();
315                $result = $result->result;
316            } while ($result instanceof Promise);
317
318            if ($result instanceof PromiseInterface) {
319                $result->wait(false);
320            }
321        }
322    }
323}
